تعتزلي (form VIII)
# تَعْتَزِلِي (taʕtazilī) /taʕ.ta.zi.liː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
# تُعْتَزَلِي (tuʕtazalī) /tuʕ.ta.za.liː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
